findings.quote:
draw_keymap_overlay(app, area, frame.buffer_mut(), app.palette());
    draw_body(app, frame);
findings.what: The overlay is drawn before `draw_body`, not after, so the body paints over the mute and keymap box and the overlay is hidden or overwritten on every body, contradicting the doc comment's 'after whichever body drew'.
